name: New method proposal
about: Propose a new training load or training response method
title: "[Method] "
labels: method proposal
assignees: ""
---

## Method

Name of the method and a short description of what it computes.

## Primary reference (required)

Full citation (authors, year, title, journal, volume, pages, DOI) of the
publication in which the formula was **originally** published. Secondary
sources, reviews or software documentation are not sufficient on their own.

## Formula

The formula as given in the primary reference, with the equation or page
number where it appears.

## Reference values for testing

Published worked examples, tables or an independent reference implementation
that could be used for numerical tests.

## Limitations and assumptions

Known limitations of the method (identifiability, assumptions, sensitivity to
missing data, interval width, etc.).

## Use case

Why this method would be useful in trainingmodels.
